DEU.3.19.primary_usx_text: But your wives, and your little ones, and your cattle, (I know that ye have much cattle), shall abide in your cities which I have given you,
DEU.3.19.comparison_usfm_text: But your wives, and your little ones, and your cattle (I know that ye have much cattle), shall abide in your cities which I have given you,
DEU.3.19.source_print_resolution: Use no comma after cattle before parenthesis in printed verse 3:19

DEU.28.58.primary_usx_text: If thou wilt not observe to do all the words of this law that are written in this book, that thou mayest fear this glorious and fearful name, Jehovah thy God;
DEU.28.58.comparison_usfm_text: If thou wilt not observe to do all the words of this law that are written in this book, that thou mayest fear this glorious and fearful name, JEHOVAH THY GOD;
DEU.28.58.source_print_resolution: Original printed edition uses small capital JEHOVAH THY GOD in verse 28:58; preserve capitalized lettering in derived verse text
